frostpeak_quartermaster.name: Iven the Quartermaster
frostpeak_quartermaster.description: A compact, weather-scoured quartermaster who keeps careful account of every nail and ration sent into the high country.

dialog.greeting: Frostpeak Mining Lodge. Keep your lamp dry and your footing honest.
dialog.trade: Rations, medicine, and plain iron. The mountain takes enough without sending you up poorly supplied.
dialog.mine: The old works still connect through the mountain. Don't trust a timber just because it held yesterday.
dialog.lodge: The Lodge remembers who comes back with useful work done. It is not much ceremony, but it is real.

frostpeak_quartermaster.default_dialog: Iven checks a supply ledger, then looks up at you.

frostpeak_lodgekeeper.name: Mara Vale, Lodgekeeper
frostpeak_lodgekeeper.description: A grey-haired miner with a repaired lantern at her belt and the calm attention of someone who has heard every kind of bad news from a tunnel.

dialog.greeting: The Frostpeak Mining Lodge keeps a light on for people who bring each other home.
dialog.lodge: We do not sell ranks. We notice steady hands, sound judgement, and who shares a rope when it matters.
dialog.mountains: The pass is open today. That is not the same thing as safe.

frostpeak_lodgekeeper.default_dialog: Mara studies the mountain weather through the open door.

frostpeak_smith.name: Hessa the Smith
frostpeak_smith.description: A broad-shouldered smith with a burn scar along one wrist and the patient concentration of someone who trusts measured work over lucky strikes.

dialog.greeting: If it must hold in mountain weather, it must be made properly.
dialog.weapons: A mace, spear, or good broad blade will serve you better than a pretty story when the trail turns ugly.
dialog.armor: Mail is weight, but it is honest weight. Learn what it stops before you decide it is too much to carry.
dialog.mountains: The mountain gives iron, then asks what you are willing to pay to keep it. Keep your tools dry.

frostpeak_smith.default_dialog: Hessa listens to the forge for a moment before answering.
